1: // Minimal Beacon Dash game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
7:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
8: 
9:   // ----- Game objects -----
10:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 50, w: 20, h: 30, speed: 4 };
11:   const beacons = [];
12:   const asteroids = [];
13:   let score = 0;
14:   let gameOver = false;
15: 
16:   // ----- Input handling -----
17:   const keys = {};
18:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
19:     keys[e.key] = true;
20:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
21:   });
22:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
23: 
24:   // ----- Audio setup -----
25:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
26:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
27:   const playTone = (freq, dur, type = 'sine') => {
28:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
29:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
30:     osc.type = type;
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.connect(gain);
33:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
36:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
37:     osc.start();
38:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
39:   };
40:   const playCollect = () => playTone(800, 0.1);
41:   const playExplosion = () => playTone(150, 0.3, 'triangle');
42:   const playThrust = () => playTone(400, 0.05);
43: 
44: 
45:   // ----- Utility -----
46:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
47:   const rectCollide = (a, b) =>
48:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
49: 
50:   // ----- Spawn -----
51:   const spawnBeacon = () => {
52:     beacons.push({ x: rand(0, width - 20), y: -20, w: 20, h: 20, speed: 2 });
53:   };
54:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
55:     const size = rand(15, 35);
56:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(0, width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: rand(1.5, 3) });
57:   };
58:   // spawn intervals
59:   let beaconTimer = 0,
60:     asteroidTimer = 0;
61: 
62:   // ----- Main loop -----
63:   const loop = () => {
64:     if (gameOver) {
65:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
66:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
67:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
68:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
69:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
70:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
71:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
72:       return;
73:     }
74: 
75:     // clear
76:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
77:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
78: 
79:     // starfield (twinkling)
80:     // pre‑generated stars for consistent twinkle
81:     if (!window._stars) {
82:       window._stars = Array.from({ length: 80 }, () => ({
83:         x: rand(0, width),
84:         y: rand(0, height),
85:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
86:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3,
87:       }));
88:     }
89:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
90:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
91:     // draw gradient overlay for depth
92:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
93:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
94:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
95:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
96:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
97:     // draw stars with slight flicker
98:     window._stars.forEach(s => {
99:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha + Math.random() * 0.2})`;
100:       ctx.beginPath();
101:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
102:       ctx.fill();
103:     });
104: 
105:     // update ship
106:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
107:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
108:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
109:       ship.y -= ship.speed;
110:       playThrust();
111:     }
112:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
113:     // keep inside canvas
114:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
115:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
116: 
117:     // draw ship (gradient triangle with thrust)
118:     // main hull
119:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
120:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4cff4c');
121:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#00aa00');
122:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
123:     ctx.beginPath();
124:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
125:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
126:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
127:     ctx.closePath();
128:     ctx.fill();
129:     // thrust flame when moving up
130:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
132:       ctx.beginPath();
133:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
134:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 4, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
135:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2 + 4, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
136:       ctx.closePath();
137:       ctx.fill();
138:     }
139: 
140:     // spawn beacons/asteroids
141:     beaconTimer++;
142:     asteroidTimer++;
143:     if (beaconTimer > 100) { spawnBeacon(); beaconTimer = 0; }
144:     if (asteroidTimer > 150) { spawnAsteroid(); asteroidTimer = 0; }
145: 
146:     // update and draw beacons (glowing circles)
147:     for (let i = beacons.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
148:       const b = beacons[i];
149:       b.y += b.speed;
150:       // radial gradient for glow effect
151:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, 0, b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w);
152:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
153:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
154:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
155:       ctx.beginPath();
156:       ctx.arc(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
157:       ctx.fill();
158:       // collect
159:       if (rectCollide(ship, b)) { score++; beacons.splice(i, 1); playCollect(); }
160:       else if (b.y > height) beacons.splice(i, 1);
161:     }
162: 
163:     // update and draw asteroids (gradient rocks)
164:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
165:       const a = asteroids[i];
166:       a.y += a.speed;
167:       // rock gradient
168:       const rockGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
169:         a.x + a.w / 2,
170:         a.y + a.h / 2,
171:         a.w * 0.2,
172:         a.x + a.w / 2,
173:         a.y + a.h / 2,
174:         a.w / 2
175:       );
176:       rockGrad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
177:       rockGrad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
178:       ctx.fillStyle = rockGrad;
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:       // optional slight outline
183:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
184:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
185:       ctx.stroke();
186:       if (rectCollide(ship, a)) { playExplosion(); gameOver = true; }
187:       else if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
188:     }
189: 
190:     // draw score
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
192:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
193:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
194: 
195:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196:   };
197: 
198:   // start
199:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200: })();
